how to model complex event processing and how to apply it in EA.
the development of an integrated EA modelling method for complex event modelling, which can be applied in the enterprise architecture development process.
the development of a method for modelling of complex event driven systems and their integration into EA.

the event driven approach is a suitable approach to model the business scenarios with dynamic changes.
